_source: Transcribed from the centre's official programme guide at https://aifoundationprogram.athar-dev.edu.sa/ section 07 (الخط الزمني) and section 09 (جدول الأعمال). Every date, title and description below is verbatim from the guide; nothing here is derived or invented. Extracted and then verified field-by-field against the guide text.
_session_model: ONE session per training day, 16:00–20:00 Riyadh, by the centre's decision (D-61). The guide publishes each day as TWO blocks (17:00–17:50 and 18:00–19:00) plus a 10-minute break; merging them into one session means ONE attendance check-in per day instead of two. The block titles are preserved in each session's `topic` so nothing the guide says is lost.
_guide_contradictions: Two inconsistencies inside the guide itself, recorded rather than silently resolved (D-62): (1) the intro day's three blocks run back-to-back 17:00-17:30-18:15-19:00 with no gap, yet the guide shows break rows between them, while every other day leaves a real 10-minute gap; (2) the agenda lists only TWO days for week one (Mon 07, Wed 09) while «معلومات البرنامج» states three days per week and every other week has three. Neither affects the merged model, which uses neither block times nor a day count.
